name: bg-neural

frames.best_why: Frame 5 has the brightest glowing knot with long branching filaments spread across the frame.

tagline: Electric blue filaments fork and drift across a black field.
summary: A full-bleed shader backdrop that draws thin luminous blue tendrils, brightening where they cross, over pure black. The pattern moves on its own and shifts toward the pointer.
appearance: A black field holds a few delicate blue filaments that branch like veins or lightning, with small white-hot knots where strands converge. Everything fades to black at the edges, and a small white caption sits off-centre.
behaviour: The strands crawl and re-form on a slow loop. Moving the pointer or scrolling pulls the glowing shape toward the cursor and alters its hue slightly.
search_phrases: shader background that follows the mouse
energy tendrils for a tech hero
interactive webgl background for a startup
use_when: A dark tech or AI page needs a living, glowing backdrop that reacts to the cursor.
avoid_when: It runs a WebGL loop every frame and reads the window pointer and scroll, so it reacts outside its own box.
customise: hue, saturation and chroma tune the colour and glow and className adds styles; the pattern itself and the pointer reaction are baked into the shader.
weight_why: A full-screen fragment shader with a fifteen-step loop, redrawn every frame.

a11y.note: Decorative shader canvas with no reduced-motion check, and it listens on the window for pointer and scroll.

issues: Frame 2 is nearly all black, so the effect disappears for stretches of the animation.
The caption sits over moving bright strands without a backing, so contrast varies.
polish_why: Delicate glowing filaments with real depth; some frames go almost entirely black.
title: Neural Background
